intro.text: Dark, seon-like beings of Sel. They seem to draw in the light around them, their edges fade into the air, and a ring of misty symbols circles each sphere.

description.text: They are said to rely on humankind, though whether they have masters as seons do is unknown.
Dilaf, leader of the Dakhor, learned from the skaze that Elantrians could be destroyed.

Hoid struck a bargain with a group of skaze, promising to become an Elantrian. When his first attempts failed, he was with a skaze whose lively feelings and humour reminded him how much each one's personality differs.
